__NOTOC__ Khaela is a Lightforged draenei located aboard the Vindicaar. She used to be at Arinor Gardens before leaving Argus with the Xenedar. She left her loom there.
Kendall Hudson is Test Lead in charge of the Quality Assurance Live Operations team for World of Warcraft at Blizzard Entertainment.
__NOTOC__ Ketlingr is a nightsaber ghost located at the Fields of the Eternal Hunt in Halls of Valor during the quest Night of the Wilds.

Keravnos Scouts were hydras located at the Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle. These hydras had problem with their pathing, leading them to be stuck either in the ground or below. They were seemingly removed at some point.
Kelvin Tan is Senior 3D Artist at Blizzard Entertainment. He is also Co-Founder and instructor of BrushForge.

Kezzig Klackwhistle is a goblin :Azerite miner who was stationed in Silithus with his companion Jixil after the Argus Campaign. Originally from Winterspring, Kezzig used to work in Lunnix Sprocketslip's mining supply shop and occasionally served as a guide for visitors to Everlook. He and Lunnix entered a relationship but he was forced to leave when she caught him hanging out with Gogo. Some time after the discovery of Azerite in Silithus, Kezzig was part of the extraction team that attacked the Explorers' League expedition camp guarded by the Sentinels. Kezzig personally caught Sapphronetta Flivvers‎ and brought her to Druz and Grizzek Fizzwrench in Tanaris. Kezzig, Druz, and the other guar
Kenny McBride is a Character Artist for World of Warcraft at Blizzard Entertainment. He notably made the Stormwind Skychaser mount for BlizzCon 2017 and worked on artifact weapons.
Keto is a tortollan located in Little Tortolla in Dazar'alor. He also appears in the Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Kelpfist is a sea giant located in the Collapse in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Ken "the Pig Thrower" is a human located at the Ring of Booty in Freehold.
Kevo is a house cat located in Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.

The Kelp Club is a club in the rougher part of Hook Point in Boralus. This is where the Kul Tiran Partygoers go, to forget their troubles. The Burly Bouncer at the door will make sure not just anybody gets in. The place is owned by Don Adams, the leader of the Scrimshaw gang and as such, a few of his footpads can be found among the clientelle as well.
The Key of the Sea drops from the Unleashed Tidebreaker in Boralus.
The Kelp-Encrusted Bindings are a reputation reward; you must be with Storm's Wake to purchase this item from Sister Lilyana in Stormsong Valley for .
Kelsey's Jump Boots is provided as an objective for Ship Logs.
__NOTOC__ Kerie Shadeswift is a night elf located in Drustvar.

Kenzou is a vulpera quest giver located on the western outskirts of the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun alongside Omi and Tacha. He used to be a member of a caravan, but after they tried and failed to fight the sethrak, Kenzou instead joined up with Omi and Tacha to form a scavenging crew that keep their distance from the sethrak and scavenge ruins like the Court of Zak'rajan for anything valuable. When an adventurer arrives at the court, Kenzou asks them to dispatch some of the spirits around the ruins, after which he allows them to join the crew. He then asks them to gather silk from the sandspinner spiders inside the ruins. Finally, he accompanies Omi, Tacha, and the adventurer in defeating

Keston John is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.

]] The Kezan Runner is a goblin yacht that is docked at the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. It serves as the entrance to the MOTHERLODE!! dungeon, and it is docked at the beginning of the dungeon as well.
Keys to the Silver Mono-Wheel did not make it out of the patch 8.2.0 PTR.

Keys to the Explorer's Jungle Hopper was obtainable from the patch 8.2.5 Recruit A Friend at 9 months. It is still available from legacy recruits since after patch 10.0.7 but new recruits will not count toward this.
Kevinos is a zombie occasionally summoned by Gillvanas. He is a reference to Nathanos Blightcaller.
The Kelpberry Cask is located in the Coral Forest in Nazjatar.

__NOTOC__ Kelpwillow is a coral ancient located in Nazjatar. To wake up this ancient, obtain a Prismatic Crystal (item) that are found near waterfalls, find and charm a Muck Slug with the crystal then head towards the ancient with the slug.
Kezan Stamped Bijou can be obtained from Tortollan Trader's Stock.
Keystone Initiate Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raids achievement earned by completing a Level 2 or higher Mythic dungeon within the time limit while in a guild group.
Keystone Challenger Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raids achievement earned by completing a Level 5 or higher Mythic dungeon within the time limit while in a guild group.
Keystone Conqueror Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raids achievement earned by completing a Level 10 or higher Mythic dungeon within the time limit while in a guild group.
Keystone Master Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raids achievement earned by completing a Level 15 or higher Mythic dungeon within the time limit while in a guild group.
__NOTOC__ Keraal the Ripper is a stoneborn located in the Chalice District in Revendreth.
The Kezan Blasterboots Inc. is a goblin organization responsible for creating rocket jumpers.
Kelox's Eggbeater drops from Egg-Tender Leh'go at the Dusty Burrows in Ardenweald.
Kewarin is a sylvar located at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.
Kevin's Party Supplies are looted from Slime-Coated Crates at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus.

Khaliiq is an aranakk of the House of Eyes who serves Baroness Vashj in Maldraxxus. In her mortal life, she was a Night Warrior of Elune. She plays a prominent role in both the :Necrolords Campaign and the Chains of Domination campaign.
Kere Kinblade is a Maldraxxi skeleton innkeeper located at Keres' Rest in Maldraxxus.
Keres' Rest is a base of some of the survivors of the House of Eyes, located at the entrance of their house.

Keshet is a vulpera working at an anvil next to Kark Helmbreaker (before allied races are unlocked) or Uros Hardhoof (after allied races are unlocked) at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar.
Kennel Overseers are venthyr located in Houndkeeper's Alley and the Kennels in Castle Nathria.
Keyton's Mail Pauldrons are a quest reward from Muckgill's Flipper or Something....
__NOTOC__ Keshu Treehoof was a tauren druid located in Mulgore.
Kelsey's Water Walking Boots were never made available. They would be used on the Isle of Fangs and Bay of Kings in Zuldazar.
Keybab Nibbles is a squirrel sitting on the head of Conan the Dogbarian in Nayeli Lagoon in the Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Ketess the Pillager is a tarasek located at the Talonlords' Perch in the Forbidden Reach.
__NOTOC__ Kemora is a dracthyr located in the Azure Archives Annex in Valdrakken.
Kevin's Keyring is a soulbind trait granted by Plague Deviser Marileth. It is exclusive with Plagueborn Cleansing Slime.
Kevin's Oozeling is a soulbind trait granted by Plague Deviser Marileth.
Keshki is a red dragonspawn located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. She is among the crowd of Dragonspawn Apprentices listening to Lifecaller Tzadrak.

A small, unnamed bar and grill area is located on the northern coast of the Ohn'ahran Plains, north of the Nokhud Approach and west of Stonefray Falls. Here, the grillmasters Khalla and Tuktu sell examples of their races' different cuisines to centaur, dracthyr, and tuskarr patrons. The place is decorated with a mix of centaur and tuskarr objects, along with some gorloc idols. A tuskarr boat is beached on the shore below.
__NOTOC__ Khalla is a centaur food and drink vendor located on the northern coast of the Ohn'ahran Plains, where she runs a bar and grill with Tuktu the tuskarr.
Keratin-Reinforced Wristguards are a quest reward from Storm Chasing.
Keratin-Reinforced Boots are a quest reward from Sneaking In.
Khadin is a centaur located in Khadin's Cave in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Key Fragments drop from the djaradin, elemental, and rare elite mobs and can be looted from Key Fragments at the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores. Combining 30 fragments with 3 creates a Greater Obsidian Key once a week for Allegiance to One, then repeatedly after that.

Key Framings drop from the djaradin, elemental, and rare elite mobs at the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores. Combining 3 framings with 30 Key Fragments creates a Greater Obsidian Key once a week for Allegiance to One and repeatedly after that.

Keys of Loyalty is the second in a series of two weekly elite world quests at the Obsidian Citadel. After selecting one of Sabellian or Wrathion to ally with for the week, that character will then start this world quest.
__NOTOC__ Khakad the Ancient is a proto-dragon located in the Waking Shores.
Keluzar is a blue dragonspawn located in Gelikyr Overlook in Thaldraszus. She accompanies Sharnax into the battlefield and creates a protective barrier in a building.
__NOTOC__ Kerzanthi is a dracthyr located in the Azure Span.
Kerazal is a bronze dragonspawn located in Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.

Kerwal's Paw would likely drop from Trap-Layer Kerwal in the Azure Span.

Kezan Rations would presumably be obtained in Bilgewater Port on Kezan.

The Key to Salem's Chest is required to open Dark Cleric Salem's Chest, which is located in a Scarlet Crusade camp at the northern edge of Venomweb Vale in Tirisfal Glades. It has not been known to drop anywhere to date, fueling much speculation.
Kilram is a jungle troll quest giver weaponsmith located in Everlook in Winterspring.

"Kil'jaeden and the Shadow Pact" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter III. It is set approximately 45 years before the events of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. Found at: * Second floor of Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, Duskwood * Scholomance in the Western Plaguelands * The Scarlet Bastion (live side) of Stratholme Timeline: * ← Previous book: The Last Guardian * → Next book: Rise of the Horde
Kieran is a night elf weapon vendor located in the Tradesmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
Part of the Shaman-aimed armor set called The Elements, a Dungeon Set 1 gear set.
Part of the Shaman-aimed armor set The Five Thunders, a Dungeon Set 2 gear set.

Killian Sanatha is a Forsaken vendor located on the Lordamere Lake dock near the Decrepit Fields in Silverpine Forest. Fenwick Thatros can occasionally be found next to him. When the Scarlet Crusade took control of the dock, Killian relocated to the Sepulcher.
__NOTOC__ Kil'hala is a jungle troll tailoring trainer located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the town.
__NOTOC__ Kilxx is a goblin fishing trade goods and fish vendor located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Kiknikle is a goblin cloth armor vendor located in a small camp west of Lushwater Oasis in the Barrens.
Kil'Hiwana is a jungle troll fishing trainer located at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

__NOTOC__ Khan Shaka was the leader of the Gelkis clan centaurs and once found in Gelkis Village of Desolace. When Cataclysm was released, Shaka was replaced with Khan Shodo for reasons unknown.

__NOTOC__ Khan Hratha is the khan of the Maraudine centaur. He spawns to defend the Maraudine War Horn in the Valley of Spears in Desolace during the quest Khan Hratha (Gelkis)/Khan Hratha (Magram), and is accompanied by a Maraudine Khan Guard and a Maraudine Khan Advisor. Both Uthek the Wise and Warug want a key fragment carried by Hratha.

Khorium Veins can be found across all of Outland, the Isle of Quel'Danas, and in some TBC dungeons including Auchenai Crypts, Mana-Tombs, Sethekk Halls, Shadow Labyrinth, The Slave Pens, The Steamvault, and The Underbog. Khorium Veins are a rare spawn of Fel Iron Deposits or Adamantite Deposits.

__NOTOC__ Kilt of the Night Strider drops from Broggok in the Blood Furnace wing in Hellfire Citadel.

Khazgorm's Journal is a book looted from Prospector Khazgorm at the Bael Modan digsite. It reveals a side of the Explorers' League not often seen. Gann Stonespire asks Horde players to kill Khazgorm and bring him the book for the quest Gann's Reclamation.
Kibler is a goblin quest giver located at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes. According to the parrot Opus, he is being investigated by an organization called G.E.T.A.
Khur Hornstriker is a tauren reagent and poison vendor located at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

Kil'sorrow Fortress is a large fortress in southeastern Nagrand near the border with Terokkar Forest. It is inhabited by the Kil'sorrow clan, who are agents of the Shadow Council. The area is well-defended, its wooden walls protecting a stronghold, a great hall, a kennel, and several watch towers. It is named after the great demonlord of the Burning Legion, Kil'jaeden.

Khoraazi was a planned ethereal who was meant to be a chairman of the Consortium.
Kilt of Living Growth are epic leather legs armor for druids.

He is also found in the Hall of Shadows speaking with Jes'rimon. Kilrath was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar, initially standing next to Ukos Bloodwhisper.

Khan Dez'hepah's Head drops from Khan Dez'hepah in Desolace.

Khaz'goroth's Seat is the deepest chamber located inside Uldaman, below the Hall of the Crafters. It is the last chamber of the dungeon, and is the location of its last boss, the titanic watcher Archaedas. It contains numerous earthen statues that come alive during the battle. The Discs of Norgannon and the Lore Keeper of Norgannon can be found in a small room beyond Khaz'goroth's Seat. After fiercely fighting, Archaedas' weapons were left behind, whether out of fear or respect is a mystery. The Rockpounder, the Stoneslayer, and the Archaedic Stone are among them.
__NOTOC__ Kil'rek is Terestian Illhoof's imp minion, assisting him in fight in Karazhan.
Killing Ground is the second installment of the World of Warcraft comic.
Kilt of Spiritual Reconstruction is an epic mail legs armor for casters.
Kim'Jael's Compass can be found inside Kim'jael's Equipment in Azshara.

Kilix the Unraveler is one of the few remaining nerubians that are still living. He, as well as a few others of his kind, reside within the Pit of Narjun in the Dragonblight. They are strongly opposed to Anub'arak's undead Anub'ar.
__NOTOC__ Kili'ua, also known as "the Mother of all Crabs" and "Two Huge Pincers", is a huge crab found on Kili'ua's Atoll near Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight.
Killinger the Den Watcher is a tauren found at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra.
Khu'nok the Behemoth is a giant mammoth located just west of the Scalding Pools in Borean Tundra.
Kili'ua's Atoll is an atoll just off the coast west from Moa'ki Harbor and east from the Briny Pinnacle in Dragonblight. Kili'ua, a gigantic crab, can be found here.
The Kil'sorrow Armaments can be found throughout Kil'sorrow Fortress in Nagrand.

Khan Bloodhoof is seemingly the khan of the Centaur Marauders.

Khiragg was a centaur khan who led his warband to attack the tauren of Mulgore during the invasion of Durotar. The centaur kidnapped several tauren, including Baine Bloodhoof, son of the tauren's high chieftain Cairne. This sent Cairne into a lethargy, and without his leadership, the centaur threatened to decimate the tauren. With the help of Bovan Windtotem and his outcasts, Rexxar and his companions found the centaur's camp, killed Khiragg, rescued Baine, and brought him back to his father, restoring Cairne's spirits.
Kilt of Dark Mercy is a reputation reward; you must be with Knights of the Ebon Blade to buy it from for .

Kibli Killohertz is a gnome found on the southern tower of Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. Kibli Killohertz is the commander of the Alliance Infragreen airbase and the bomber squadron based there. He is responsible for coordinating aerial attacks on Scourge ground forces in the Bombardment and on Scourge plague machines in the Valley of Lost Hope. His second-in-command and line chief is Karen No.
Kil'jaeden's Command is the finale of the Curse of the Blood Elves campaign, after the final mission, Lord of Outland.
Khit'rix the Dark Master is one of the challenges in the combat ring of Valhalas in Icecrown.

Khar'vaxal the Cracked (or Kar'xavan) was a legendary Zandalari madcap. According to legend, when facing the Zandalari's enemies for the first time, Khar'vaxal shrouded himself with a mantle woven with the "weave of madness", as well as with the blinding speed of his two daggers. His story reminds the Zandalari that chaos can be used to defeat any foe, no matter how strong, and modern-day madcaps still cherish their mantles as a sign of their place in the tribe.
Kickin' It Up a Notch is the achievement for completing all of the daily cooking quests given by The Rokk. This achievement is also criteria for the title from completing .
Killian appears to be a family name associated with quite a few undead NPCs in the World of Warcraft.
Kilt of Reborn Future is a quest reward from Children of Tortolla.
Kilrok Gorehammer is an orc quest giver located at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by the Alliance champions who besieged Hunter's Hill.

Khromuk is a Blizzard employee who posts on the US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11112 Customer Service Forum]. He was introduced on August 10, 2010 and works Monday thru Friday from 9am to 6pm Pacific Time. Unlike the other representatives, whose primary duty is to assist customers on the CS Forum, Khromuk's primary duties involved behind-the-scene work.

Khurgorn Singefeather is a Wildhammer dwarf quest giver located at Bahrum's Post in Dun Morogh. He instructs Alliance adventurers to kill the elementals at the Helm's Bed Lake end their suffering since he had been unable to calm them.
Kill Squad is a PvP guild achievement requiring the guild members to earn 100,000 honorable kills.
The Kil'sorrow are a clan of orcs part of the Shadow Council. They inhabit Kil'sorrow Fortress in Nagrand. They are aggressive to both the Horde and the Alliance.

__NOTOC__ Khan Kammah is the leader of the Magram centaur in Desolace. The Burning Blade pushed him and his clan out of their home (which the cult renamed Shok'Thokar) and forced them to take over the lands of the Kolkar clan, which they renamed the Magram Territory. Kammah is first encountered in the Magram Territory, after adventurers sent by the Kolkar Khan Leh'Prah kill enough of his warriors to force him to emerge. Although he is well aware of the threat posed by the Burning Blade, Kammah is initially reluctant to ally with Leh'Prah against the cult. However, he agrees to lend his forces to the fight after the adventurers help feed his starving clan. Kammah and the Magram later join the

__NOTOC__ Khan Shodo is the leader of the Gelkis centaur in Desolace. He is aging, and suffers from old war wounds. He therefore rarely leaves Bolgan's Hole and leaves the rule of the clan to his three sons: Rhoho, Sherik, and Jorreth. The Kolkar Khan Leh'Prah sends adventurers to kill Shodo's sons as a show of force, and then seek out the khan in Bolgan's Hole to convince him to ally with Leh'Prah against the Burning Blade. This has the opposite effect, as the deaths of his sons causes Shodo to become despondent and declare that he no longer cares about the fate of Desolace. However, he concedes that he'll consider Leh'Prah's proposal if the adventurers free his beloved daughter Kherrah, a

Kiche was the apprentice of Shotoa. After the War of the Three Hammers, the appearance of Ragnaros on Azeroth caused upheavals among the elements. Kiche was tossed into a hole during an earthquake. He managed to hold on the edge. Shotoa went after him to rescue, commanding the air spirits. However, the land collapsed and both fell.
Killing With Friends is a PvP guild achievement requiring the guild members to win 1000 ranked arena matches while in a guild group.
Khan Blizh is one of the Galak chieftains in Splithoof Heights. He deals with the Horde, while Khan Ablinh deals with the Alliance.
Khan Ablinh is one of the Galak chieftains in Splithoof Heights. He deals with the Alliance, while Khan Blizh deals with the Horde.
Kijara is a jungle troll quest giver found on the Echo Isles in Durotar.
Khaz Modan Mantle is a reward from The Battle of Thandol Span.
Khaz Modan Shoulderguards is a reward from The Battle of Thandol Span.
Khaz Modan Pauldrons are a reward from The Battle of Thandol Span.
Khaz Modan Spaulders is a reward from The Battle of Thandol Span.
Khardros' Anvil is an area within Grim Batol, the Wildhammer version of the Great Forge. It is where Forgemaster Throngus is fought and is named after Khardros Wildhammer.

Ki-Han Brewery is a small brewery located in the Rows west of the Dai-Lo Farmstead on the Wandering Isle. Raggis, a large virmen, has chased away the workers who had been busy repairing the old structure.

Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver is one of the Klaxxi paragons, a mantid champion preserved from an era long-past. He is the first paragon the player meets in the Dread Wastes. He is a proud old soldier who saw value in allowing outsiders to aid in the Klaxxi's war against .
Kil'karil is a jungle troll quest giver located at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kilt of Pandaren Promises is a random world drop from mobs in Pandaria.
Ki-Ro the Contemplative is a pandaren found in an inn in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle.
Ki'ta Arrowtusk is a jungle troll quest giver first found at Sen'jin Village and then at Razor Hill Watchtower in Durotar.
Kherrah is a centaur quest giver located at Maraudon in Desolace. She is being held prisoner by the Maraudine clan. With the death of her brothers, she is the only heir left.

Kilnmaster is an exploration achievement earned for gathering 1,000 Bloody Coins obtained from world PvP on the Timeless Isle while transformed after using a Censer of Eternal Agony or a Fire-Watcher's Oath. Both are obtained from , the Emissary of Ordos, on the eastern edge of the Blazing Way.
Killing Time is an exploration achievement earned for killing most of the non-rare mobs on Timeless Isle.
__NOTOC__ Kil'ruk's Furious Blade drops from the Paragons of the Klaxxi in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Kil'ruk's Band of Ascendancy drops from Paragons of the Klaxxi in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Ki the Assassin is a pandaren that helps out during the healer trials.

Killmaw is found at just outside Anguish Fortress on the Plains of Serenity, to the southeast of Embaari Village in central . It drops Killmaw's Canine and 10-20x Garrison Resources. Just to the northeast on the outskirts of Embaari is the Embaari Defense Crystal, another vignette.
Kheila Fallingwater is a pandaren located at the Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest. She walks back and forth between Trader Jina and Watcher Jo Lin.
__NOTOC__ Kher Shan is a tiger located inside a small cave near the Tigers' Wood in the Jade Forest.
